model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for the Mistralv0.2-Base model, both in its base form and after fine-tuning on six medical specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The horizontal axis, labeled “Per-specialty terms,” lists these six specialties in order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” is scaled linearly from -22 to -27, with tick marks at regular intervals of one unit. Each specialty has a corresponding group of six bars, each representing one of the six fine-tuning domains, color-coded as follows: light beige for Cardio, light orange for Gastro, orange for Infect, dark orange for Neuro, brown for Obstetrics, and dark brown for Pediatrics. The base model (Mistralv0.2-Base) is represented by a single light blue bar for each specialty, positioned to the left of the fine-tuned bars. Within each specialty group, the bars are arranged in descending order of negative log probability, with the base model bar consistently being the tallest (least negative, i.e., highest probability) and the fine-tuned bars generally being shorter (more negative, i.e., lower probability). The chart visually emphasizes the base model’s performance by its distinct color and position, while the fine-tuned bars show varying degrees of performance improvement or degradation across specialties.
